response.justification: The candidate lacks critical required qualifications: no demonstrated experience with C programming for UNIX/embedded systems, no Linux kernel modification experience, no exposure to embedded networking or security technologies like MACsec or 802.1X, and no Japanese language proficiency — all of which are non-negotiable for this role.
strengths: Strong full-stack experience across multiple languages and platforms
Proven ability to build and maintain complex systems (e.g., GISCollective, AI-agent tooling)
Active contributor to open-source and developer tooling with strong testing practices
concerns: No C programming experience in embedded/UNIX environments as required
No demonstrated knowledge of embedded networking security protocols (MACsec, 802.1X, etc.)
No Japanese language proficiency — a mandatory requirement

key_factors.factor: No Linux kernel or security protocol experience
